title: Reduce Gaussian phase payload work by 25–50 percent
body:
This local algorithmic improvement reduces the retained Gaussian phase pass from `18V+h` to `9V+(9/2)V_odd+h` payload tape transitions. Even phases stream directly; odd phases use one real-half scratch tape. The bill includes reads, writes, moves, scratch clearing, input retirement and output rewind. From an origin head, the saving is 25–50%. The phase polynomial, output bits, affine word, compact operations and inverse chronology are preserved. There is no change to the complete kappa calculation.

The [proof](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/999f5d4047c05d9baef769e586b658b9a1e1e76d/research/streaming-gaussian-phase-tariff/PROOF.md), [exact receipt](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/999f5d4047c05d9baef769e586b658b9a1e1e76d/research/streaming-gaussian-phase-tariff/RESULT.json) and [source manifest](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/999f5d4047c05d9baef769e586b658b9a1e1e76d/research/streaming-gaussian-phase-tariff/SOURCES.json) define the result. V is payload volume, V_odd is the portion with odd phase, and h is the initial head offset. The proof covers valid complete record layouts and all coefficient widths b>=2, exactly modulo 2^b and on signed Gaussian integers with the stated headroom. It uses three payload roles in total and at most b scratch bits. Encoded phase arithmetic and the full caller remain separate charges.

For both actual event8814 right/left recipes, V=32768 and V_odd=16384. Each phase pass decreases from 589824 to 368640 transitions, exactly 37.5%. The complete monomial wrapper also has the same endpoint and retains every ordinary call. The percentage applies to the phase component, not the whole monomial, wall time or recursive supplier.

Base: canonical main `7c472563474e60185e6ca101a17622133d047e56`, priority revision 7. @jmbarrancoml supplied the scan, affine/compact routines and proof in [PR #2250](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2250); the consumed [source proof](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/7c472563474e60185e6ca101a17622133d047e56/research/selected-complex-compact-adapters/PROOF.md) retains Douglas Colkitt's compact construction. @JoyboyBrian supplied the actual fixture in [PR #5327](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5327), with Cinna Davis and the native/Clifford lineage credited in the [packet source](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/7c472563474e60185e6ca101a17622133d047e56/research/complex-four-base-packet/README.md). The Word RAM phase work in [PR #4538](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4538) and Gaussian normalization in [PR #3127](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3127) are related work with different operations/models, not consumed implementations.

Use CPython 3.12 with no third-party packages, from the repository root:

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/streaming-gaussian-phase-tariff
```

Expected status: `PASS_STREAMING_GAUSSIAN_PHASE_TARIFF_NO_NEW_KAPPA`. Normal and optimized CPython 3.12.13, committed-byte checks, the official 14-file export and a Git-free optimized replay passed. Source and typed-receipt corruption were rejected. Evidence includes 21824 coefficient/phase cases, 768 tensor/polynomial/inverse patterns, four actual complete monomial comparisons, two compact tensor round trips, three arithmetic discriminators and three executed input rejections. Every measured payload bill equals the proved formula; unchanged source execution and an independent integer phase oracle agree.

No full supplier, native catalogue replay, encoded-control lowering, Lean, Docker or selected cold replay was run. Optional full-history checks are unavailable in this shallow checkout. Full caller composition, recursive C, precision and supplier pricing remain open. The selected frontier is unchanged. Prepared by Ali Romman with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; Apache-2.0. No independent human or proof-kernel review is claimed.
